metadata.what: Kodak Elite Chrome 200: Kodak's consumer edition of the film in kodak_ektachrome_e200.
metadata.data: None of its own. KODAK ELITE Chrome 200 Film (publication E-148) publishes the same spectral sensitivity, characteristic and dye density curves as KODAK PROFESSIONAL EKTACHROME Film E200 (E-28): digitised from both sheets they agree to within 0.0002 (log sensitivity, density). The engine loads kodak_ektachrome_e200 and overrides only the name.
